Body.Content:
Power Pages now supports secure site ownership transfer for eligible sites. Existing site owners and global administrators can assign ownership to another valid user within the tenant without requiring manual intervention from support.

The new owner must be a valid user with appropriate access to the environment. Every ownership transfer is recorded in an auditable history, including the previous owner, new owner, initiating user, and timestamp. Notifications are sent to the previous owner, the new owner, and administrators to ensure transparency and continuity and the changes get logged into Compliance Center.

To help organizations maintain governance standards, Power Pages also identifies sites that no longer have a valid owner and surfaces this information on Power Advisor. Administrators can review these sites and take corrective action to ensure every production site has a designated accountable owner.

This feature improves lifecycle management, reduces administrative overhead, and helps organizations maintain secure and compliant ownership practices across their Power Pages deployments.

Business Value:

Your organization needs a reliable way to transfer ownership of Power Pages sites when responsibilities change due to team reassignments, role changes, or employee departures. This feature helps maintain accountability, prevents orphaned sites, improves governance compliance, and ensures administrators always have visibility into who is responsible for managing a site. Built-in auditing and notifications provide traceability and help your organization meet operational and compliance requirements.

Enabled for:

Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

GA date: September CY2026

Preview date: September CY2026
